scope: Bounded arxiv primary-source scout and source-as-data review. This JSON records literature and proposed refinement obligations; it admits no new mathematical source, crypto protocol or Python implementation.

literature.title: Authenticated Append-only Skip Lists
literature.result_and_assumptions: Commits to indexed sequence contents and order, with membership and advancement proofs. Dynamic verification retains size, digest and basis authenticators; checking only a newly received digest is insufficient. Security arguments require a computationally bounded adversary and collision-resistant hashing, plus the specified proof checks and previously trusted commitment. This is not an unconditional injectivity theorem for a finite digest, nor a theorem that arbitrary local logs have one globally agreed history.
literature.verification_here: Primary text inspected; construction not implemented or independently replayed.

literature.title: Formal Verification of Authenticated, Append-Only Skip Lists in Agda: Extended Version
literature.result_and_assumptions: Agda results establish agreement or an existential hash collision. The dependency interface requires distinct decreasing hop targets, noncrossing hops, no zero-index hops and positive successor levels. Authenticator lemmas use injective encoding and fixed-size concatenation; the index encoding is fixed-width in their treatment. A full polynomial-time security reduction remains future work.
literature.verification_here: Paper inspected; linked development not fetched or rerun.

literature.title: SoK: Authenticated Prefix Relations -- A Unified Perspective On Relative Time-Stamping and Append-Only Logs
literature.result_and_assumptions: Defines commit/certify/verify for prefix relations between finite ordered sequences, keeping prefix authentication distinct from membership. Hash-based constructions require secure hashing and an appropriate acyclic graph; aggregation uses a fixed total order. Authentication concerns supplied digests and lengths. Fork detection needs communication between views; the structure alone does not prevent a malicious maintainer presenting divergent histories.
literature.verification_here: Primary definition and assumptions inspected; no implementation or new security claim.

external_source_identity: Pinned arxiv version IDs and primary URLs; PDF/HTML bytes were inspected through browser tooling and were not retained or cryptographically hashed by this scout. Version labels do not constitute our formal replay.

ordered_history_contract.exact_statement: For lists old and new of actual records, AppendOnly(old,new) means there exists a suffix tail with new = old ++ tail.
ordered_history_contract.proposed_operational_check: Reject unless both values are lists, len(new) >= len(old), and every old position equals the corresponding complete new row under the explicitly defined record equality. On success return new[len(old):] as the suffix witness.
strictly_weaker_controls: Set inclusion loses occurrence order and multiplicity.
Equal cardinality or an unchanged ID set permits permutations and row rewrites.
ID-keyed literal row preservation permits reordering and insertion before historical rows.
Equal digests alone need an independent authentication/collision model and source commitment.
ordered_history_contract.boundary: A mathematical proof for lists and exact equality does not by itself prove JSON parsing, Python equality, filesystem behavior, CAS mutation or cryptographic authenticity.

facts_read_as_data: pack uses dictionary = (entries.map Prod.snd).dedup; the comment specifies rightmost payload occurrence retention.
References are mapped from every original entry; repeated keys and payload occurrences are retained in order.
The stated exact contract unpack(pack(entries)) = some entries concerns finite Lean lists and DecidableEq Payload. It needs no hash-injectivity assumption.

Repacking a longer source list need not preserve a raw prefix of dictionary slots or numeric references. Prefix preservation belongs to decoded source entries unless a separate stable-interning policy is specified.

source_derived_example_not_replayed.meaning: Decoded old entries are the exact first two new entries; payload-slot positions and old numeric references changed under rightmost dedup. This is a source-derived calculation, not an added compiled Lean example.

codec_review.revision_condition: DictionaryRevision.AgreesOnReferences requires exact optional-lookup equality at every retained reference. Reusing old references after slot reordering violates that premise. Repacking all references is a different operation that is justified by each full round trip, rather than fixed-reference agreement.
codec_review.failure_caveat: The local failed_decoders_do_not_imply_agreement example shows equal none results can hide a later disagreement; require successful decoding and/or per-reference agreement, not equality of two failing results.
codec_review.runtime_boundary: scripts/cache_math.py stores zlib-compressed raw byte objects and checks bytes/digests/lengths. It is not established here as a Python refinement of the Lean pack/unpack definitions.

current_operational_gap.observed_behavior: Old decisions/contributions/aliases are looked up by ID and compared literally; previous row order need not survive. Stable method IDs are preserved by set inclusion.
current_operational_gap.relation_to_lean: This keyed-retention condition does not imply the incoming ordered AppendOnly predicate. A prefix checker is a strict operational strengthening, not an inference from the existing test count.

proposed_refinement_obligations.statement: Prove the chosen executable checker true iff there exists a suffix producing exact list equality; include shrinking, permutation, front insertion, multiplicity and edited-row hostile cases.

Define the Record representation and type-sensitive equality. Python can equate True with 1 and 1 with 1.0; JSON parsing/canonicalization must reject or distinguish such cross-type cases, duplicate keys, nonfinite values and unsupported fields before claiming correspondence.
Use successful exact round trips to transfer a prefix fact for original entries to decoded packed objects. Do not assert the interned payload dictionary itself is append-only.
Prove or separately audit parsing, serialization, payload equality, dictionary/index behavior and the runtime decoder against the Lean definitions. Runtime finite bounds and failure cases must match.

Bind exact ordered row bytes/identities and parent revision, freeze/read back current sources, and perform expected-current CAS under the core lock. A pure prefix checker does not perform atomic commit or establish durable disk state.

Treat literal history preservation independently from hash collision resistance, trusted genesis/checkpoints, signatures, inter-view communication and permissions. Do not replace the exact-list premise with digest equality without a justified cryptographic model.

The source-as-data review adds no replay. Any newly formalized checker/result needs pinned --trust=0, fatal warnings, owned-declaration axiom audit and relevant consumer evidence. Incoming Provenance candidate native statuses remain NOT_RUN.

claims_not_made: No novelty or priority claim for ordered-prefix preservation, exact interning or authenticated histories.
No unconditional digest injectivity, global fork prevention, source authenticity, standing permission or complete catalogue claim.
No Riemann-sphere compactification theorem follows from byte compression or indexed dictionaries.
No incoming source native status or historical receipt was rebound.
